3-501.16
Cold time/temperature control for safety food not adequately temperature controlled.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTIONCorrected On Site
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cold held at 5 degrees C (41 degrees F) or less. Eggs shall be stored at a temperature of 7 degrees C (45 degrees F) or less.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Observed Thai and Italian dressings stored at room temperature at time of inspection. The items were both at 70F. These items were made in the establishment. Staff voluntarily discarded the items at time of inspection. This will be marked as corrected on site.
3-501.19
Written procedure for time control not available.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Written procedures shall be prepared in advance, maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: At time of inspection, butter was observed to be stored at room temperature. No written procedure or logs were observed. Staff voluntarily discarded the items at time of inspection. The establishment must email inspector of written procedures for using time as a public health control within 10 days.
3-201.11
Food obtained from an unapproved source.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with law.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: At time of inspection, observed bagels that were made in Costco. Discussed that Costco does not have a wholesale license so it would not be considered an approved source. The establishment must remove the Costco bagels from the establishment within 3 days and email written verification to inspector.
3-101.11
Food not safe, adulterated and or honestly presented.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Food shall be safe, unadulterated, and honestly presented.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Observed on menu that the establishment offers wheat grass shots and aloe vera juice with the following description underneath: "energize, detoxify, alkalize, gut health." Discussed that retail food establishments cannot serve food with health claims. The establishment must remove these descriptions within 3 days and email photo verification to inspector.
